title: Targeting quorum sensing in Pseudomonas aeruginosa: Novel benzo[d]imidazole-based LasR inhibitors with tunable head, alpha,beta-unsaturated linker, and tail segments.
authors: Mohammed, Esraa Z; El-Zoheiry, Haidy H; Abd El-Aleam, Rehab H; Naga, Nourhan G; Mabrouk, Mona E M; Mehany, Ahmed B M; Abdel-Aziz, Hatem A; Ibrahim, Noha M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苯并咪唑类化合物抑制铜绿假单胞菌LasR群体感应系统，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子配体互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Targeting quorum sensing is a promising anti-virulence strategy to combat Pseudomonas aeruginosa pathogenicity and antimicrobial resistance. Based on this, a series of benzo[d]imidazoles derivatives were rationally designed, synthesized and structurally elucidated. Two alpha,beta-unsaturated linkers-based scaffolds were investigated: acrylonitrile-linked (7a-g, 9a-c) and prop-2-enone-linked (13a-f, 15a-d) derivatives encompassing both NH-unsubstituted and N-methylated benzo[d]imidazole analogues. Antimicrobial evaluation of all the target compounds against P. aeruginosa PAO1 showed inhibition zones of 18-26 mm and MIC values ranging from 15.6 to 125 mug/mL. Among these, compounds 7d, 9a, 13b, and 15b exhibited the highest antibacterial activity. At sub-inhibitory concentrations ((1/2) MIC), the tested compounds significantly suppressed key virulence factors, including protease production, biofilm formation, and motility phenotypes (twitching and swarming) (7d; 70.4, 79.4, 57.9, 74.7%), (9a;58.0, 55.4, 75.0, 62.7%), (13b;72.6, 86.0, 65.8, 65.3%), (15b;83.3, 81.8, 65.8, 66.7%), respectively. In vitro LasR antagonism assays confirmed effective quorum sensing inhibition (IC(5)(0) values: 7d= 0.261, 9a= 0.94, 13b= 4.32, 15b= 3.04 muM). Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations validated the potency of 7d, revealing stable binding within the LasR active site, characterized by favorable hydrophobic interactions and disruption of receptor dimerization. Collectively, these findings identify 7d as a promising lead benzo[d]imidazole analogue possessing dual antibacterial and antivirulence activities, through quorum sensing interference via LasR inhibition.
abstract_zh: 靶向群体感应是应对铜绿假单胞菌致病性和抗菌药物耐药性的一种有前景的抗毒力策略。基于此，合理设计、合成并结构解析了一系列苯并[d]咪唑衍生物。研究了两种基于α,β-不饱和连接基的骨架：丙烯腈连接（7a-g, 9a-c）和丙-2-烯酮连接（13a-f, 15a-d）的衍生物，涵盖NH未取代和N-甲基化苯并[d]咪唑类似物。对所有目标化合物针对铜绿假单胞菌PAO1的抗菌评价显示，抑菌圈为18-26毫米，最低抑菌浓度（MIC）值范围为15.6至125微克/毫升。其中，化合物7d、9a、13b和15b表现出最高的抗菌活性。在亚抑菌浓度（(1/2) MIC）下，受试化合物显著抑制关键毒力因子，包括蛋白酶产生、生物膜形成和运动表型（抽搐运动和群集运动），分别为（7d；70.4、79.4、57.9、74.7%）、（9a；58.0、55.4、75.0、62.7%）、（13b；72.6、86.0、65.8、65.3%）、（15b；83.3、81.8、65.8、66.7%）。体外LasR拮抗实验证实了有效的群体感应抑制（IC(5)(0)值：7d= 0.261，9a= 0.94，13b= 4.32，15b= 3.04微摩尔）。分子对接和分子动力学模拟验证了7d的效力，揭示其在LasR活性位点内稳定结合，其特征在于有利的疏水相互作用和受体二聚化的破坏。总体而言，这些发现将7d确定为一种有前景的先导苯并[d]咪唑类似物，通过LasR抑制干扰群体感应，具有双重抗菌和抗毒力活性。
